items.title: Shah’s India visit to focus on reviewing ties and expanding cooperation, foreign ministry says
items.desc: A 34-member official delegation will accompany the prime minister for high-level talks, project inaugurations and agreements across several sectors during the two-day visit.

items.title: Salyan to reassess 756 earthquake-hit households
items.desc: Repeated assessments have delayed relief and reconstruction for earthquake survivors in Darma Rural Municipality, where 1,600 households have yet to receive even the first instalment of government assistance.

items.title: Floral festoons ritual marks Haribodhini Ekadashi at Bagmati river
items.desc: The annual ritual at Pashupatinath involves stringing flowers across the river, a practice believed to invoke Lord Vishnu’s blessings and cleanse sins.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI draws rave reviews as gamers enter Vice City
items.desc: Gamers worldwide flocked to the latest instalment of the blockbuster franchise, with launch parties, rave reviews and millions of downloads marking the release of the long-awaited game after a 13-year wait.

items.title: Nagdhunga tunnelway collects Rs16.4 million in tolls in first 15 days
items.desc: The tunnelway carried 119,029 vehicles, generating revenue of Rs16.44 million, while its annual operating costs are estimated at Rs220 million.

items.title: Anthropic’s blockbuster debut tests Wall Street’s faith in AI boom
items.desc: Anthropic’s shares surged 17 percent on their first day of trading, briefly valuing the AI company at $2 trillion, as investors weighed its growth prospects against mounting concerns over the sustainability of the AI boom.

items.title: Nepal closer to having FIFA suspension lifted after NSC revokes domestic ban
items.desc: Five months after government interference froze Nepali football with FIFA ban, the domestic suspension on ANFA was lifted on Thursday. The development comes after talks between the Nepali government, FIFA and AFC in Thailand on Thursday.

items.title: Three seasons, three finals—Sudurpaschim Royals do it again
items.desc: The Royals defeated Chitwan Rhinos in Qualifier 2 on Thursday to book a seat in the final for the third consecutive season.

items.title: Can Bidya Bhandari change the fate of UML and the leftist movement?
items.desc: Former president says she will work to foster cooperation among fragmented Nepali communists.

items.title: Old differences continue to weigh on Nepal-India ties
items.desc: Successive prime ministers have secured deals on trade, energy and connectivity, but the 1950 treaty, border disputes, and Pancheshwar project remain on table for Shah’s visit.

items.title: The air we breathe shouldn’t kill us. Tackle Nepal’s air pollution head-on
items.desc: Nepal’s air quality crisis demands urgent action as hazardous pollution levels pose severe health risks.

items.title: Why Nepal’s statutory rape law needs a close-in-age exemption
items.desc: A gender-neutral, queer-inclusive close-in-age exemption in Nepal’s statutory rape law would be a necessary, if modest, fix.

items.title: When Shah meets Modi: Can they rewrite history?
items.desc: Nepal-India ties will only reset if both sides move beyond transactional diplomacy.

items.title: Sudurpaschim reach third straight NPL final, set up title clash with Lumbini
items.desc: Tharindu Ratnayake’s unbeaten 53 guides Sudurpaschim Royals to a three-wicket victory over Chitwan Rhinos in Qualifier 2.

items.title: At Seto Gumba, there’s more to being a nun than prayer and meditation
items.desc: Over 80 Buddhist nuns at the monastery in western Kathmandu blend daily kung fu practice with meditation, disaster relief, environmental advocacy, and skills traditionally associated with men.

items.title: Shah likely to skip guard of honour, airport farewell for India visit
items.desc: No formal ceremony is planned so far for a guard of honour ahead of the state visit.

items.title: Indian border restrictions stall development projects in Tinkar, Chhangru
items.desc: Drinking water projects and a suspension bridge in Darchula’s northern villages remain incomplete after SSB personnel stopped construction materials from entering Nepal despite diplomatic clearance.

items.title: Nepal to seek measures to boost exports during PM’s India visit
items.desc: Kathmandu plans to seek easier access for Nepali products, resolve certification hurdles, review anti-dumping duties on jute goods and expand access to Indian ports.

items.title: Malan’s 71 takes Chitwan to 133 against Sudurpaschim
items.desc: Chitwan Rhinos set the Royals a target of 134 in Qualifier 2, with the winner advancing to the final against Lumbini Lions.

items.title: Top UN court finds Myanmar committed state-sponsored genocide against Muslim Rohingya
items.desc: The International Court of Justice says Myanmar’s military carried out mass killings, rape and village destruction in 2017 with the intent to destroy part of the Rohingya population, in a landmark ruling with implications for other genocide cases.

items.title: Nepal plans to let investors trade rights entitlements on stock exchange
items.desc: The move would permit shareholders unable or unwilling to buy additional shares a chance to earn money from their entitlements instead of letting them go unused.

items.title: Trump, Xi, Putin conclude historic meeting on Ukraine war, nuclear arms
items.desc: The leaders discussed Ukraine, nuclear disarmament and regional conflicts, but deep divisions over security, trade and Taiwan cast doubt on whether the unprecedented meeting would produce concrete agreements.

items.title: Fatal crashes keep claiming lives on Hetauda-Kathmandu road
items.desc: Three people died in Thursday’s jeep crash, a week after a microbus accident killed 14 in Bhimphedi. The 82-km route has seen 30 crashes and 22 deaths this fiscal year alone.

items.title: Nepal and Bangladesh to play historic T20I at Lord’s in June
items.desc: The fixture, which is historic for both the countries, will take place as part of the MCC-hosted Nepal tour to England, where the Rhinos will play against Scotland and Ireland.

items.title: CIB obtains arrest warrant for former chief secretary over Malaysia worker scam
items.desc: Six people, including two former labour ministers, have been arrested over allegations that money collected illegally from Nepali workers was sent to Malaysia.

items.title: ANFA suspension lifted after months of restrictions
items.desc: The National Sports Council reverses its action against the football governing body as Nepal seeks to address concerns raised by international football authorities.

items.title: Bhandari accuses government of targeting political opponents, media
items.desc: Former president Bidya Devi Bhandari says due process and democratic freedoms are being undermined, urging political parties to unite in defence of the constitution.

items.title: Three killed, seven injured in jeep crash in Makawanpur
items.desc: The passenger vehicle veered off the Hetauda-Bhaise road and plunged into a stream early Thursday while travelling from Rautahat to Kathmandu.
